name: WakingApp
description: Tel Aviv AR company (founded 2013) whose cloud platform let businesses build interactive 3D/AR experiences via drag-and-drop or JavaScript, with white-label and native-app integration, used for training, advertising, healthcare and automotive. Acquired by Scope AR in December 2019.
notes: Israeli entity recorded as voluntarily dissolved (Jan 2026) per registrar data on startupim.
